source-metadata.description: Topology of the speak project — a CLI tool that adds narration intelligence to text-to-speech. Diagrams whole-project structure (engines, voices, models, services, tools, artifacts) and recent trajectory (commits introducing the Chirp 3 HD engine and the offline Kokoro engine). N-ary state_change edges are preserved as single edges with role incidences — synthesize is one event with engine/model/voice/output, not a chain of dyadic links.
source-metadata.extractor: claude (claude-opus-4-7), manual extraction from codebase + git history
source-metadata.anti-reification-discipline: No node is created for: TTS Pipeline, Engine Selection, Optimization Step, Voice Mapping, Synthesis Process, Audio Generation Process. Each of those is an n-ary edge between persistent things, not a thing. Concepts that ARE reified (narration-intelligence, audio-tags-vocabulary) appear as entities because the README and source code reference them by name as addressable things, per the i2t reification rule.
